clauses.rule: The 2017 video depicts a standard master with shadows on both sides. The strict legacy single-component geometry is not exhaustive. A standard-range candle with two positive shadows, combined fraction near or above 0.8 under the existing numerical comparison, and no legacy dominant component is a diagnostic split-shadow candidate. Flag selected or intervening candidates for source-variant review; never silently discard them, automatically select them, or grant confirmation. The inclusive boundary is engineering policy, not newly verified teacher wording.

Separate shadow-length review, which ignores the body as a shape condition, from pinbar-family review, which adds a body condition. Body fractions refer to whole candle range; shadow/ATR is a different ratio. Keep workbook thresholds unchanged. The new audio does not establish exact ATR branch boundaries, equality rules or a universal self-cover ratio.

A counter-colour bar is not automatically a new wave; no-pivot or bypass context remains required. The video shows a two-bar distance alternative. Do not equate minimum three directional standard bars with a universal raw bar count. The existing fixed three-ATR comparison remains a bounded engineering profile; approximate examples do not establish universal new thresholds. A cover of a split-shadow diagnostic candidate makes a no-pivot assertion require review.

A small candle does not automatically replace an existing master. This contract follows the archived written answer's precedence of an actual master over a virtual line; this is not a verified chronological supersession. The archive timestamp does not establish when the answer was spoken or written. The old video's virtual-line example has unresolved context; do not merge the two into a universal fallback algorithm.

Exact zero noise differs from small positive noise. Recognized exception-pivot exemption and membership of a fresh shape remain distinct. A pivot does not establish a reached entry area or a closed trigger setup; unreached entry areas do not produce trades. Single-pinbar confirmation subtype remains unresolved.

Archive attachment links, displayed question numbers, internal record IDs and spoken content are separate evidence. The audio attached to records 152 and 164 differs in topic from adjacent written answers; do not call those texts transcripts or use the question number to settle ambiguous audio. ASR repetition is not independent listening.
